decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core coating know-how into the corrosion-protection niche, and it remains listed on the website with no sign of withdrawal.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and documented field use in construction repair, which points to continued market relevance.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses the proven air motors, so keeping it costs little and it complements the firm's material conveying range.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's goal of digitalized, interoperable production and keeps its own dedicated page, so dropping it is unlikely.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system sits close to the firm's core offer and was only launched in 2024, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
